person_man/concept:
Hand-painted semi-realistic HD isometric game art, like the best classic 2D castle city-builders:
soft painterly shading, rich natural material texture, warm late-summer light from the upper left,
soft shadow to the lower right, tallgrass prairie, lake and oak woodland palette, no outlines,
no text.
Character/model sheet of an invented everyday adult man, 1.72 m tall, believable proportions with head 1/7.5 body height, calm neutral face, skin midtone #A8704A, long black hair in two plain braids over the shoulders and thin plain hide headband, front, side and back views, neutral standing pose, plain flat light grey background, full body, the same scale in every view.
Clothing exactly: simple long-sleeved thigh-length dyed hide shirt in neutral grey #A8A8A8 with a single thin plain white/blue/rust bead band across shoulders, natural hide leggings #A97F52, dark brown moccasins #6B4A2E, plain hide belt and small pouch. Plain bead bands only. No feathers, no regalia, no text, no labels. No weapons, sacred objects, painted symbols, caricature, pure black or logos.
